[[File:Cooling_unit.png|thumb|A cooling unit panel lacking a power cell.]]
A '''cooling unit''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] component that required [[Energy cell/Legends|energy cells]] to power it. It was used on [[Action VI bulk transport/Legends|Action VI transports]].<ref name="JA">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy]]''</ref> [[Turbolaser/Legends|Turbolasers]] utilized cryogenic cooling units.<ref name="CCG-Turbolaser">{{CCG|set=Premiere Limited|cardname=Turbolaser Battery}}</ref>

In [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jaden Korr]] became stranded on [[Blenjeel]] while on a [[Mission to Blenjeel|mission]]. He successfully took another ship's energy cell and installed on his transport to power the cooling unit in order to get out of the planet.<ref name="JA" />
